Estimating from the photo: the plate holds two slices of toast, and I'm assuming they are medium-thick white bread, about 40 g each, or 80 g in total. Toasting removes some moisture, so I'll call it 75 g.

Toast at about 265 kcal per 100 g gives roughly 200 kcal.

The items off the plate (butter, honey, tea with milk) are not "on the plate," so I'm leaving them out. The question says "everything on the plate," which I read as the toast only. If the whole tray were counted, the total would be higher.

Counting the toast alone, that is about 200 kcal and 75 g.
